name: unnoticed-double-sort

finding.title: `config_keys_help` sorts `KNOWN_KEYS` twice
finding.description: `has_duplicates` copies and sorts `KNOWN_KEYS`, and `config_keys_help` then copies and sorts the same keys again to print them. `KNOWN_KEYS` is the fixed array of 12 keys declared just above, and the help text is built once per `--help` run, so the second sort is one more sort of 12 short strings.
finding.suggestedFix: Sort once and check the sorted copy for neighbours that are equal, or move the duplicate check into a unit test.
